name: 48444 · Imlay City, MI
findings: ZIP 48444 (Imlay City) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48444 (Imlay City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48444 (Imlay City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
